name: Revolver Resources Holdings Ltd
summary: Revolver Resources Holdings Ltd is an Australian company finding and developing deposits of copper and other base metals. It fully owns the Osprey project, six exploration permits over about 765 square kilometers in the Mt Isa Mineral province of North-West Queensland, and the Dianne project in the Hodgkinson Province, with six mining leases and one exploration permit. Established in 2021, it is headquartered in Brisbane.
